checkout_changed: The checkout at {path} no longer matches branch {branch} in this repository
checkout_unverified: Cannot verify that branch {branch} at {path} is safe to reuse: {reason}
checkout_in_use: Branch {branch} is checked out at {path} and is in use by Agent {owner}
checkout_dirty: Branch {branch} is checked out at {path} and has uncommitted changes; use that checkout explicitly or keep the changes before retrying
path_taken: The checkout path {path} already exists and is not empty; Persona neither reuses nor overwrites it
no_commits: {path} has no commits yet, so a new worktree cannot be made from it; commit once, or work in the folder itself
agent_branch_exhausted: No branch name is free for the Agent’s worktree: its name and the next 49 are all taken
